image_description: A large, teal and white airship (dirigible) with 'DREAMLAND 1897' text on the side, hovering low over a grassy park area. The airship has an orange nose cone and visible gondola structure underneath. In the background, there are trees and a large rock formation resembling a face. In the foreground, part of a silver car is visible.

The texture of the envelope is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the subtle fabric seams or panel lines typical of real dirigibles.
The foreground car roof appears slightly warped, and the perspective of the grass slope feels inconsistent with the airship's position.
